import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", rc={"axes.facecolor": "#f0f0f0", "figure.facecolor": "#f0f0f0"})

# Create a figure and axes for the plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create the violin plot combined with a swarm plot
# This visualization effectively shows the distribution of fares paid by passengers,
# segmented by their class and survival status. The violin plot shows the density,
# while the swarm plot shows individual data points, preventing overlap.
sns.violinplot(
    data=df,
    x="class",
    y="fare",
    hue="alive",
    split=True,
    inner="quart",
    palette={"no": "#c0392b", "yes": "#27ae60"},
    order=["First", "Second", "Third"],
    ax=ax
)

sns.swarmplot(
    data=df[df['fare'] < 100], # Swarm plot for lower fares to avoid clutter
    x="class",
    y="fare",
    hue="alive",
    dodge=True,
    size=2.5,
    palette={"no": "#c0392b", "yes": "#27ae60"},
    order=["First", "Second", "Third"],
    ax=ax,
    legend=False # Hide the swarmplot's redundant legend
)

# --- Customization for Clarity and Insight ---

# Set a logarithmic scale for the y-axis to better visualize the wide range of fares
ax.set_yscale('log')

# Format y-axis ticks to be more readable (e.g., 1, 10, 100) instead of scientific notation
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.ScalarFormatter())
ax.yaxis.set_minor_formatter(mticker.NullFormatter())
ax.set_yticks([1, 10, 50, 100, 200, 500])


# Set title and labels with more descriptive text
ax.set_title(
    'Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Fare Paid',
    fontsize=18,
    fontweight='bold',
    pad=20
)
ax.set_xlabel(
    'Passenger Class',
    fontsize=12,
    fontweight='bold'
)
ax.set_ylabel(
    'Fare (Log Scale)',
    fontsize=12,
    fontweight='bold'
)

# Customize the legend
handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax.legend(
    handles[:2], # Display only the first two handles (for the violin plot)
    ['Did not survive', 'Survived'],
    title='Survival Status',
    title_fontsize='13',
    loc='upper right'
)

# Add an annotation to provide context
ax.text(
    0.98, 0.90,
    'Higher fares within each class correlate with higher survival rates.\nLog scale on fare axis highlights differences in lower fare brackets.',
    transform=ax.transAxes,
    fontsize=10,
    verticalalignment='top',
    horizontalalignment='right',
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.5', fc='#f0f0f0', alpha=0.8, ec='grey')
)

# Final layout adjustment
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96]) # Adjust layout to make room for suptitle

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
